claim_boundary: This analysis measures fitting-seed variation with constructed rows held fixed. It is reported separately from scan-resampling intervals and does not establish dataset-level generalization.
construction_seed_policy: frozen calibration table and linked-pair identities; no resampling
linear_seed_contract: deterministic zero initialization and deterministic full-batch optimization; seed labels are repeated-execution identifiers
selection_policy: active model fixed before robustness analysis; no reselection
